purpose: This table cleans the bronze ourairports_airports capture into a silver airport reference table, one row per airport identified by id, feeding downstream airport lookup and geospatial joins.
usage: Consumers should join on id (or ident/iata_code/icao_code/gps_code/local_code when matching external airport code schemes) and must handle nulls in elevation_ft, municipality, icao_code, gps_code, local_code, home_link, wikipedia_link, and keywords since these columns are sparsely populated and never imputed.
limitations: Pipeline metadata columns (_airbyte_raw_id, _airbyte_extracted_at, _airbyte_meta) were dropped; local_code (63.7% null), home_link (74.9% null), and keywords (68.0% null) remain heavily sparse and were not backfilled or excluded; no exact duplicate rows were found (duplicate_row_rate 0.0) so no dedupe logic beyond the stated grain was applied.
